title: Pip and the Frog in the Rain
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 57-sound stage (dr, fl, fr just added).

pages.text: Pip is on a flat log.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow standing on a flat fallen log beside a compost heap.

pages.text: Drip, drip, drip. Rain is on the log.
pages.illustration: Raindrops falling steadily onto the flat log, small puddles forming.

pages.text: Pip flaps in. Pip sits in a gap.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow flying into a dry gap under the edge of the compost heap, folding his wings.

pages.text: A frog sits in the gap too!
pages.illustration: A small green frog already sitting in the same dry gap, turning to look at Pip.

pages.text: Pip and the frog sit. Drip, drip, drip.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and the small green frog sitting side by side in the dry gap, rain still falling outside.
Pip the sparrow and the frog both settled and still, watching the rain from the dry gap.

pages.text: The rain is not so bad.
pages.illustration: The rain easing outside the gap, drops falling more lightly now.

pages.text: The sun is up. Pip and the frog hop off.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and the frog stepping out of the gap into fresh sunshine.

pages.text: Pip and the frog are pals. Pip had fun.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and the small green frog sitting together happily on the dry log in the sun.
